reader.requirement: At --std 85 no line of a page heading report group may be presented on or below integer-3 (FIRST DETAIL, defaulting to integer-2) of the PAGE clause: the last permitted line is integer-3 minus 1, for absolute lines, for relative lines placed from HEADING (no report heading on the page) and for relative lines placed after the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER; since 1985 has no PRESENT WHEN the placement is fixed by the description and a violation is a description the compiler refuses (SR8b, LINE NUMBER SR1).

edition-consulted.switches: passes Edition.DialectLevel to GroupLimits, Cobol85FinalLineCounter and RelativeGroupLowerLimit; the body-group SR9 screen is year<2002 only (not this rule)
year<2002: a relative page heading is walked from the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER (its last line or its NEXT GROUP); from 2002 null, walked from HEADING
year<2002: the page heading's limit is FIRST DETAIL - 1 cited to §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR1c; from 2002 the same number with §2023 words
takes year but the page heading arm (HEADING, FIRST DETAIL - 1) is the same at every edition

reader.notes: The lower limit is enforced at compile time, which is complete at 1985 because no PRESENT WHEN exists and the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER is fixed by the description (Cobol85FinalLineCounter). Classes a, d, e, f do not apply to a line-placement limit of a heading group; the absolute-line diagnostic text cites §2023 words although the 1985 limit it enforces is the same number (cosmetic).
